items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word allows unauthorized remote code execution over the network, making it a prime vector for phishing-driven ransomware.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的网络远程代码执行，使其成为网络钓鱼驱动勒索软件的主要攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Graphics Kernel enables local privilege escalation, potentially granting kernel-level access to compromised endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Graphics Kernel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能向受感染终端授予内核级访问权限。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Windows PowerShell weakens script execution policies and allows unauthorized local code execution, undermining endpoint defense mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 中的代码注入漏洞会削弱脚本执行策略并允许未经授权的本地代码执行，从而破坏终端防御机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office enables network-based code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user productivity environments and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，对终端用户生产力环境和横向移动构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows NTFS allows unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting core file system handling routines.
items.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的不信任指针解引用漏洞允许未授权的网络攻击者通过利用核心文件系统处理例程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Desktop Window Manager facilitates local privilege escalation, compromising graphical subsystem stability and endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Desktop Window Manager 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可促成本地权限提升，破坏图形子系统稳定性和终端安全性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap overflow in Xbox Live Networking Service enables unauthorized remote code execution over the network, posing a critical threat to connected gaming and enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Xbox Live Networking Service 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的堆溢出漏洞可引发未经授权的网络远程代码执行，对联网游戏和企业环境构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows NAT component allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code over the network, directly compromising network address translation infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT component 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，直接危及网络地址转换基础设施。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the SMB Server transport driver permits authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, continuing the historical risk profile associated with SMB-based lateral movement attacks.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server transport driver 中的竞态条件漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行代码，延续了与基于 SMB 的横向移动攻击相关的历史风险特征。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows unauthenticated remote code execution when processing malicious media files, significantly expanding the attack surface for drive-by and phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理恶意媒体文件时可引发未认证的远程代码执行，显著扩大了针对自动下载和钓鱼活动的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Print Spooler Components enables unauthenticated remote code execution over adjacent networks, maintaining the print spooler's status as a persistent and highly exploitable target.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler Components 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过相邻网络实现未认证的远程代码执行，巩固了 Print Spooler 作为持久且极易被利用目标的状态。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows remote code execution over a network, posing a critical threat to client endpoints via malicious media payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可引发网络远程代码执行，通过恶意媒体载荷对客户终端构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer overflow in Windows Color Management enables remote code execution over a network, severely impacting system stability and security posture.
items.reason_zh: Windows Color Management 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的整数溢出漏洞可引发网络远程代码执行，严重影响系统稳定性和安全态势。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.0 use-after-free vulnerability in the Virtual Filtering Platform permits remote code execution, bypassing standard kernel isolation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Virtual Filtering Platform 中 CVSS 评分为 9.0 的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，从而绕过标准内核隔离机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 relative path traversal in Windows Print Spooler Components allows remote privilege escalation, leveraging a historically targeted and widely deployed service.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的相对路径遍历漏洞可实现远程权限提升，利用了历史上常被针对且广泛部署的服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Color Management allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. Its 9.8 CVSS score and broad client-side attack surface make it a critical priority for patching.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行远程代码。其 9.8 的 CVSS 评分和广泛的客户端攻击面使其成为补丁修复的优先事项。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in LSASS enables local privilege escalation targeting Windows credential protection mechanisms. Exploitation directly facilitates credential dumping and lateral movement in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，针对 Windows 凭据保护机制。利用该漏洞可直接促进企业环境中的凭据转储和横向移动。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the Windows Kernel allows local privilege escalation by compromising core OS memory management. This vulnerability undermines fundamental security boundaries and system stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的越界写入漏洞可通过破坏核心操作系统内存管理实现本地权限提升。该漏洞破坏了基本的安全边界和系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution in DirectMusic allows network attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication, impacting widespread Windows deployments.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中的关键远程代码执行漏洞允许网络攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下执行任意代码，影响广泛的 Windows 部署。

items.reason_en: High-severity stack-based buffer overflow in DirectMusic enables remote code execution over networks, posing a significant threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中的高危基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，对端点安全构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based overflow in the Raw Image Extension permits remote attackers to execute code by processing malicious image files, affecting common Windows image handling workflows.
items.reason_zh: Raw Image Extension 中的基于堆的溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过处理恶意图像文件执行代码，影响常见的 Windows 图像处理工作流。

items.reason_en: Exploitable reparse point creation allows sandboxed processes to escape containment and elevate privileges locally, undermining system integrity.
items.reason_zh: 可被利用的重解析点创建漏洞允许沙箱进程突破隔离限制并在本地提升权限，破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: UI layer bypass in Visual Studio Code could allow attackers to circumvent security features locally, compromising developer environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的用户界面层绕过漏洞可能允许攻击者在本地规避安全功能，危及开发者环境。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in AMD Vivado Lab Solutions could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code with elevated permissions on engineering workstations.
items.reason_zh: AMD Vivado Lab Solutions 中的本地权限提升漏洞可能允许攻击者在工程工作站上使用高权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A heap-based out-of-bounds write in LibreCAD's DWG parser enables remote code execution when users open malicious CAD files.
items.reason_zh: LibreCAD 的 DWG 解析器中存在基于堆的越界写入漏洞，当用户打开恶意 CAD 文件时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in 7-Zip's CAB extraction allows memory corruption when processing crafted multi-volume archives, posing a direct RCE risk to end-users.
items.reason_zh: 7-Zip 的 CAB 解压模块中存在堆越界写入漏洞，在处理构造的多卷归档文件时会导致内存损坏，直接对用户造成远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: PackageKit Zypp Backend flaw enables unprivileged users to roll back security updates, facilitating local privilege escalation to root.
items.reason_zh: PackageKit Zypp Backend 缺陷允许无特权用户回滚安全更新，从而促成向 root 权限的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Apport crash reporter executes ldd on attacker-controlled binaries while running as root, allowing unprivileged local attackers to gain elevated privileges.
items.reason_zh: Apport 崩溃报告程序在以 root 运行时会对攻击者控制的二进制文件执行 ldd，使无特权的本地攻击者能够获取提升的权限。

items.reason_en: A local authenticated user can exploit a privileged symlink dereference in Cockpit's SSH helper to escalate privileges, directly threatening system administration environments.
items.reason_zh: 本地已认证用户可利用 Cockpit SSH 辅助工具中的特权符号链接解引用漏洞提升权限，直接威胁系统管理环境。

items.reason_en: Emacs Flymake mode executes arbitrary code from untrusted files during syntax checking, posing a direct code execution risk to developers editing external documents.
items.reason_zh: Emacs Flymake 模式在语法检查期间会从不受信任的文件中执行任意代码，直接威胁编辑外部文档的开发者的代码执行安全。

items.reason_en: GIMP's PSD plug-in contains a stack-based buffer overflow triggered by crafted image files, which can lead to application crashes or arbitrary code execution upon opening malicious assets.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PSD 插件包含由构造的图像文件触发的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，打开恶意资源时可能导致应用程序崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Vim's netrw plugin allows arbitrary script execution via crafted filenames containing quote characters, enabling local attackers to run shell commands with the user's privileges.
items.reason_zh: Vim 的 netrw 插件允许通过包含引号字符的构造文件名执行任意脚本，使本地攻击者能够以用户权限运行 Shell 命令。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the CAD file parser enables RCE with user interaction, posing direct threats to engineering workstations handling untrusted project files.
items.reason_zh: CAD 文件解析器中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在需要用户交互的情况下实现远程代码执行，直接威胁处理不受信任项目文件的工程工作站。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the AR file parsing module allows arbitrary code execution, significantly compromising desktop CAD environments.
items.reason_zh: AR 文件解析模块中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许任意代码执行，严重危及桌面 CAD 环境。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the XE file parser leads to RCE, highlighting critical memory safety risks in professional design software.
items.reason_zh: XE 文件解析器中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了专业设计软件中关键的内存安全风险。

items.reason_en: SketchUp SKP parser UAF flaw permits RCE upon opening malicious files, affecting widespread 3D modeling users across architecture and engineering fields.
items.reason_zh: SketchUp SKP 解析器的释放后使用漏洞在打开恶意文件时可导致远程代码执行，影响建筑与工程领域广泛使用的 3D 建模用户。

items.reason_en: libilbm heap overflow enables RCE via crafted images, impacting any desktop application relying on this graphics library for rendering.
items.reason_zh: libilbm 堆溢出漏洞可通过构造的图像实现远程代码执行，影响任何依赖此图形库进行渲染的桌面应用程序。

items.reason_en: Unbounded busy loop in GNOME remote desktop VNC TLS handler causes severe resource exhaustion, threatening Linux desktop availability when VNC is exposed.
items.reason_zh: GNOME 远程桌面 VNC TLS 处理程序中的无界忙循环会导致严重的资源耗尽，在 VNC 暴露时威胁 Linux 桌面的可用性。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android permits network-based spoofing attacks, threatening mobile communication integrity and user trust.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的代码注入漏洞允许基于网络的欺骗攻击，威胁移动通信完整性和用户信任。

items.reason_en: Origin validation failure in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network-based spoofing attacks, which could facilitate credential harvesting or man-in-the-middle interactions on corporate mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的源验证失败漏洞可导致基于网络的欺骗攻击，可能在企业移动设备上促成凭据收集或中间人交互。

items.reason_en: GV-Face Android application transmits sensitive credentials over unencrypted HTTP, exposing authentication data to passive network interception attacks.
items.reason_zh: GV-Face Android 应用通过未加密的 HTTP 传输敏感凭据，使认证数据暴露于被动网络拦截攻击之下。

items.reason_en: The Zephyr Project charger driver fails to validate union members before crossing the user/kernel boundary, exposing function pointers that could lead to kernel compromise on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr Project 充电器驱动程序在跨越用户态/内核态边界前未能验证联合体成员，暴露了函数指针，可能导致移动设备内核被攻破。

items.reason_en: Critical missing authentication on the Linksys router JNAP API allows remote attackers to manipulate device configurations and initiate insecure Wi-Fi setups without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Linksys 路由器 JNAP API 存在关键的身份验证缺失漏洞，允许远程攻击者在无需凭据的情况下操纵设备配置并启动不安全的 Wi-Fi 设置。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Xbox firmware enables remote attackers to execute code over the network, potentially compromising gaming consoles and associated ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Xbox 固件中的高危堆溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，可能危及游戏主机及相关生态系统。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Copeland XWEB EVO controllers allows attackers to take full control of HVAC systems without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB EVO 控制器中的未经身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞允许攻击者在无需凭据的情况下完全控制 HVAC 系统。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded backdoor credentials in Copeland XWEB EVO firmware enable immediate administrative access across deployed industrial devices.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB EVO 固件中的硬编码后门凭据可使攻击者立即获取已部署工业设备的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: A critical command injection flaw in Chengdu Feiyuxing technology endpoints permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: Chengdu Feiyuxing technology 终端存在关键命令注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者以 root 权限执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Intelbras PoE switch web interface suffers from improper authentication, enabling remote attackers to manipulate core system functions without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Intelbras PoE 交换机 Web 界面存在身份验证缺陷，使远程攻击者无需凭据即可操纵核心系统功能。

items.reason_en: Axis Communications firmware contains a critical flaw allowing complete system compromise, impacting widespread IP camera and surveillance deployments.
items.reason_zh: Axis Communications 固件包含关键漏洞，可导致系统完全沦陷，影响广泛的 IP 摄像头及监控部署。

items.reason_en: NervesHub CLI login flow suffers from session fixation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to hijack user API tokens and manage IoT fleets.
items.reason_zh: NervesHub CLI 登录流程存在会话固定漏洞，允许未认证攻击者劫持用户 API 令牌并管理物联网设备群。

items.reason_en: A remotely exploitable heap buffer overflow in the D-Link router's HNAP handler allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full device takeover, compromising home network security.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 路由器的 HNAP 处理程序中存在可远程利用的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未认证攻击者完全接管设备，破坏家庭网络安全。

items.reason_en: The Synology DSM Auth API suffers from a critical SQL injection flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks on network-attached storage devices.
items.reason_zh: Synology DSM Auth API 存在关键 SQL 注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者读取或写入任意文件，并对网络附加存储设备发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Microchip TimePictra platform contains a stored XSS vulnerability that enables low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts executed by other users viewing the smart home hub interface.
items.reason_zh: Microchip TimePictra 平台存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，使低权限攻击者能够注入恶意脚本，当其他用户查看智能家居集线器界面时触发执行。

items.reason_en: Philips Hue Bridge Pro fails to properly protect its authentication mechanism, allowing network-adjacent attackers to bypass login requirements and gain unauthorized control over smart lighting ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Philips Hue Bridge Pro 未能妥善保护其身份验证机制，允许网络邻近攻击者绕过登录要求，未经授权控制智能照明生态系统。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated clients can manipulate registry tokens in Red Hat Quay to install persistent signing keys, severely compromising container image supply chain integrity.
items.reason_zh: 未认证客户端可操纵 Red Hat Quay 中的注册表令牌以安装持久化签名密钥，严重破坏容器镜像供应链完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL wildcard injection in Quay's robot account listing exposes sensitive credentials and metadata, risking unauthorized access to private container registries.
items.reason_zh: Quay 机器人账户列表中的 SQL 通配符注入会暴露敏感凭据和元数据，导致私有容器注册表面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines enables network RCE. Threatens CI/CD workflows and automated build/deployment environments used in cloud-native development.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 中的命令注入可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE），威胁云原生开发中使用的 CI/CD 工作流及自动化构建/部署环境。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Modern Device Management allows network RCE. Compromises enterprise device lifecycle management and configuration enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Modern Device Management 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE），危及企业设备生命周期管理与配置强制执行。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Deployment Services enables network RCE. Impacts OS imaging and mass deployment operations across corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Deployment Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE），影响企业网络范围内的操作系统镜像制作与批量部署操作。

items.reason_en: Use of uninitialized resource in Windows Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation. Poses risks to virtualized workloads and hypervisor isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中使用未初始化资源可导致本地权限提升，对虚拟化工作负载及超隔离边界构成风险。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Azure Kubernetes Service allows container breakout and local privilege escalation on underlying host nodes.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中的权限管理不当可导致容器逃逸，并在底层宿主机节点上实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure Confidential Clean Rooms enables unauthorized network tampering, directly violating data isolation and compliance guarantees.
items.reason_zh: Azure Confidential Clean Rooms 中缺失授权检查可导致未授权的网络篡改，直接违反数据隔离与合规性保证。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Windows Admin Center permits remote privilege escalation, jeopardizing centralized infrastructure management and orchestration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center 中的授权检查不当可导致远程权限提升，危及集中式基础设施管理与编排工作流。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 authorization bypass in Entra Device Registration enables full tenant identity compromise and unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Entra Device Registration 中存在 CVSS 评分为 10.0 的授权绕过漏洞，可导致租户身份完全沦陷，并支持通过网络进行未授权权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on Azure OpenAI allows remote privilege escalation, exposing sensitive AI workloads and underlying cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 缺失身份验证可导致远程权限提升，暴露敏感的 AI 工作负载及底层云基础设施。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Graph threatens core enterprise API integrations by allowing network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graph 中的授权逻辑错误可通过基于网络的权限提升，威胁核心企业级 API 集成。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Managed Grafana enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, risking sensitive cloud monitoring data and control plane access.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Grafana 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可导致网络未授权权限提升，危及敏感云监控数据与控制平面访问权限。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Azure Front Door allows network attackers to elevate privileges, potentially disrupting global traffic routing and service availability.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 中的权限分配错误可使网络攻击者提升权限，可能破坏全球流量路由与服务可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 path traversal vulnerability in Azure CycleCloud allows unauthorized information disclosure over a network, exposing sensitive cloud deployment configurations and credentials.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中存在 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的路径遍历漏洞，可导致网络未授权信息泄露，暴露敏感的云部署配置与凭据。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure DevOps Server via user-controlled keys allows network-based privilege escalation. This directly threatens CI/CD pipeline integrity and secure software delivery workflows.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps Server 中通过用户可控键值实现的授权绕过可导致基于网络的权限提升，直接威胁 CI/CD 流水线完整性与安全软件交付工作流。

items.reason_en: Near-perfect CVSS score indicates critical authentication flaws in Azure DevOps that allow remote code execution, threatening CI/CD pipelines and source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: 接近满分的 CVSS 评分表明 Azure DevOps 存在关键身份验证缺陷，可导致远程代码执行，威胁 CI/CD 流水线与源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud allows authenticated users to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands across cloud-managed compute clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许已认证用户提升权限，并在云托管计算集群中执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Severe SSRF vulnerability in IBM API Connect enables attackers to probe and access internal network resources from exposed API gateways.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 中存在严重的 SSRF 漏洞，使攻击者能够从暴露的 API 网关探测并访问内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Another critical SSRF flaw in IBM API Connect poses a high risk of internal network reconnaissance and data exfiltration in enterprise API management setups.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 中的另一处关键 SSRF 漏洞在企业级 API 管理架构中带来极高的内部网络侦察与数据外泄风险。

items.reason_en: Improper partition handling in Red Hat's confidential computing stack could expose sensitive guest VM data during automated boot processes.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat 机密计算栈中的分区处理不当可能在自动化启动过程中暴露敏感的访客虚拟机数据。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in Hugging Face Datasets allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by crafting malicious pickle-backed datasets.
items.reason_zh: Hugging Face Datasets 中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，攻击者可通过构造恶意的基于 pickle 的数据集来执行任意 Python 代码。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Replicate Cog enables attackers to force the application to make unauthorized internal network requests.
items.reason_zh: Replicate Cog 中存在服务器端请求伪造漏洞，攻击者可强制应用程序发起未授权的内部网络请求。

items.reason_en: OpenShift bootstrap node approves CSRs without identity validation, allowing install network attackers to extract kubeconfig and escalate to cluster admin.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift 引导节点在未进行身份验证的情况下批准 CSR，允许安装网络中的攻击者提取 kubeconfig 并提升权限至集群管理员。

items.reason_en: Amazon Braket schema validation uses unsafe reflection, potentially executing arbitrary code when retrieving quantum task results from S3.
items.reason_zh: Amazon Braket 的模式验证使用不安全的反射机制，在从 S3 检索量子任务结果时可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: HarnessRouter console attaches internal server keys to requests before validation, risking unauthorized access to self-hosted AI agent harnesses.
items.reason_zh: HarnessRouter 控制台在验证前将内部服务器密钥附加到请求中，可能导致对自托管 AI 代理工具链的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Missing query depth limits in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security's GraphQL API enable authenticated attackers to exhaust control plane resources, disrupting Kubernetes management operations.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security 的 GraphQL API 缺少查询深度限制，已认证的攻击者可借此耗尽控制平面资源，从而破坏 Kubernetes 管理操作。

items.reason_en: ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus allows authenticated technicians to escalate privileges beyond their intended scope via insufficient permission validation, potentially leading to remote code execution in cloud-managed environments.
items.reason_zh: ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus 因权限验证不足，允许已认证的技术人员突破预期范围提权，可能在云管理环境中导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Multiple ManageEngine products contain an authenticated remote code execution flaw in the Reports module with a high EPSS score, indicating strong real-world exploitation potential against IT asset management platforms.
items.reason_zh: 多个 ManageEngine 产品的 Reports 模块存在已认证的远程代码执行漏洞，且具有较高的 EPSS 评分，表明针对 IT 资产管理平台的实际利用潜力较强。

items.reason_en: Red Hat gvproxy's network forwarder endpoint lacks proper socket path validation, enabling unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the host system running containerized workloads.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat gvproxy 的网络转发器端点缺乏适当的套接字路径验证，使未认证的攻击者能够删除运行容器化工作负载的宿主机上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: Memory overflow during packet processing in Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway can trigger unpredictable behavior or denial of service, disrupting critical network edge operations.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway 在处理数据包时发生内存溢出，可能引发不可预测的行为或拒绝服务，从而中断关键的网络边缘操作。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows DNS allows local privilege escalation. Compromises name resolution infrastructure critical for network routing and service discovery.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致本地提权。该漏洞会破坏对网络路由和服务发现至关重要的名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager enables network RCE. Legacy messaging services remain deployed in enterprise networks for asynchronous communication.
items.reason_zh: Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可触发网络远程代码执行。企业网络中仍部署着用于异步通信的遗留消息服务。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in Windows iSCSI allows network privilege escalation. Risks storage area network (SAN) connectivity and underlying data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中存在链接解析不当漏洞，可导致网络提权。该漏洞威胁存储区域网络连接及底层数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Insufficient access control in Windows IKE Extension allows local spoofing. Weakens VPN and secure tunnel establishment mechanisms used for remote access.
items.reason_zh: Windows IKE Extension 中存在访问控制不足漏洞，可导致本地欺骗。该漏洞削弱了用于远程访问的 VPN 和安全隧道建立机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Client for NFS allows local privilege escalation. Exposes cross-platform file sharing protocols to exploitation in mixed-OS environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Client for NFS 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地提权。该漏洞使跨平台文件共享协议在混合操作系统环境中面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables network-based privilege escalation, directly threatening secure remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可实现基于网络的提权，直接威胁安全远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows DNS Server allows network-based code execution, directly impacting critical name resolution infrastructure and enterprise connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中存在非信任指针解引用漏洞，可导致基于网络的代码执行，直接影响关键的名称解析基础设施和企业网络连接。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows iSCSI enables unauthorized network attackers to execute code, compromising storage area network connectivity and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中存在释放后使用漏洞，使未授权的网络攻击者得以执行代码，从而破坏存储区域网络连接与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS Server permits remote code execution over a network, potentially disrupting critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络执行远程代码，可能破坏关键的名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 out-of-bounds write in Windows DNS Server enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to manipulate DNS traffic and compromise network routing.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的越界写入漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使攻击者能够操纵 DNS 流量并破坏网络路由。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows DHCP Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. As a foundational network service, exploitation disrupts IP allocation and enables immediate infrastructure takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在越界读取漏洞，可导致未认证的远程代码执行。作为基础网络服务，其被利用后会破坏 IP 分配并实现基础设施的即时接管。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server allows network-based code execution with elevated privileges. Compromising DNS services critically impacts name resolution and internal network routing.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许以高权限执行基于网络的代码。DNS 服务被攻破将对名称解析和内部网络路由造成严重影响。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server permits unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. This exacerbates risks to critical DNS infrastructure and facilitates persistent network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许未认证的远程代码执行。这会加剧关键 DNS 基础设施的风险，并便于实施持久的网络侦察。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Windows DNS allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, directly impacting core infrastructure resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在双重释放漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，直接影响核心基础设施的解析服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening the stability and security of enterprise name resolution.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁企业名称解析的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Windows DNS permits remote code execution, making it a prime target for network-level attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中对不信任数据进行反序列化可导致远程代码执行，使其成为网络级攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Microsoft QUIC allows unauthenticated denial of service over the network, disrupting modern encrypted transport protocols.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中存在空指针解引用漏洞，可导致未认证的远程拒绝服务，破坏现代加密传输协议。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Fortinet FortiManager allows attackers to escalate privileges and gain unauthorized administrative control over managed firewalls.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiManager 中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，攻击者可借此提权并获得对受管防火墙的未授权管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer permits authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary system commands, compromising network monitoring infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证管理员执行任意系统命令，从而破坏网络监控基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unicode-based command injection in ManageEngine DDI Central enables cluster operators to inject malicious DHCP configurations, disrupting network services.
items.reason_zh: ManageEngine DDI Central 中存在基于 Unicode 的命令注入漏洞，使集群操作员能够注入恶意的 DHCP 配置，从而破坏网络服务。

items.reason_en: Hickory-dns SVCB/HTTPS record parser panics on malformed input, causing denial of service in DNS resolvers and network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Hickory-dns 的 SVCB/HTTPS 记录解析器在处理畸形输入时发生崩溃，导致 DNS 解析器和网络基础设施遭受拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: OWASP CRS regex-assembly include suffers from ReDoS, effectively disabling Unix RCE detection rules in compatible web application firewalls.
items.reason_zh: OWASP CRS 的 regex-assembly include 存在 ReDoS 漏洞，导致兼容型 Web 应用防火墙中的 Unix RCE 检测规则失效。

items.reason_en: Grafana Elasticsearch proxy forwards unrestricted requests using plugin credentials, allowing index mapping alterations and cross-index data access.
items.reason_zh: Grafana Elasticsearch 代理使用插件凭据转发未受限制的请求，致使攻击者可篡改索引映射并实现跨索引数据访问。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation errors in FortiOS iBGP processing allow neighbor routers to inject malformed routing attributes, potentially causing widespread traffic redirection or network instability.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS iBGP 处理过程中的数值截断错误使邻居路由器能够注入畸形路由属性，可能导致大规模流量重定向或网络不稳定。

items.reason_en: ManageEngine DDI Central exposes an authentication bypass in Windows DNS/DHCP agent APIs, allowing unauthenticated attackers to impersonate onboarded servers and perform unauthorized network configuration changes.
items.reason_zh: ManageEngine DDI Central 的 Windows DNS/DHCP 代理 API 存在认证绕过漏洞，允许未授权攻击者伪装成已注册服务器并执行未经授权的网络配置变更。

items.reason_en: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer versions suffer from an authorization bypass via user-controlled keys, granting unauthorized access to critical security analytics, log management, and threat intelligence functions.
items.reason_zh: 部分版本的 Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 存在基于用户可控密钥的授权绕过漏洞，导致攻击者可未授权访问关键安全分析、日志管理及威胁情报功能。

items.reason_en: Hickory DNS contains a DNSSEC validation flaw that accepts invalid ancestor-delegation records, enabling on-path attackers to spoof DNS responses and compromise resolver integrity for downstream clients.
items.reason_zh: Hickory DNS 存在 DNSSEC 验证缺陷，会接受无效的祖先委派记录，使中间人攻击者能够伪造 DNS 响应，破坏下游客户端的解析器完整性。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Johnson Controls EasyIO firmware allows unauthorized access to industrial control systems, risking operational technology safety and availability.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO 固件存在认证绕过漏洞，允许未授权访问工业控制系统，危及运营技术（OT）的安全性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Remote denial of service in the BACnet Stack via crafted RTP packets can disrupt building automation and environmental control systems.
items.reason_zh: 利用构造的 RTP 数据包可在 BACnet Stack 中触发远程拒绝服务，导致楼宇自动化及环境控制系统中断。

items.reason_en: A stack-buffer-overflow in BACnet Stack's property reading logic allows attackers to trigger crashes or potentially execute arbitrary code in embedded controllers.
items.reason_zh: BACnet Stack 的属性读取逻辑存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可借此触发系统崩溃或在嵌入式控制器中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write vulnerabilities in BACnet Stack's notification class implementation enable remote exploitation of building management networks.
items.reason_zh: BACnet Stack 的通知类实现存在越界写入漏洞，使攻击者能够远程利用楼宇管理网络。

items.reason_en: Beckhoff TcRouter.sys exposes IOCTL calls allowing low-privileged attackers to access arbitrary physical memory and fully compromise PLCs.
items.reason_zh: Beckhoff TcRouter.sys 暴露了 IOCTL 调用接口，允许低权限攻击者访问任意物理内存，从而完全控制 PLC。

items.reason_en: NXP ENET-QOS driver improperly handles DMA descriptors, risking packet processing failures and potential exploitation in embedded industrial networks.
items.reason_zh: NXP ENET-QOS 驱动程序对 DMA 描述符的处理不当，可能导致数据包处理失败，并在嵌入式工业网络中面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Exposed IOCTL calls in Beckhoff's TcRouter.sys permit low-privileged processes to access hardware I/O ports, enabling complete compromise of industrial automation systems.
items.reason_zh: Beckhoff TcRouter.sys 暴露的 IOCTL 调用允许低权限进程访问硬件 I/O 端口，致使工业自动化系统面临被完全控制的风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP code injection via the WordPress REST API in the Insert PHP plugin enables attackers to execute arbitrary server-side code and fully compromise web applications.
items.reason_zh: Insert PHP 插件通过 WordPress REST API 存在未授权 PHP 代码注入漏洞，攻击者可借此执行任意服务端代码并完全控制 Web 应用。

items.reason_en: Flaws in Keycloak's credential reset flow allow unauthenticated attackers to force password resets for any user, undermining enterprise identity and access management controls.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 的凭据重置流程存在缺陷，允许未授权攻击者强制重置任意用户密码，削弱企业身份与访问管理（IAM）控制机制。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Visual Studio Code enables network RCE. Affects developer toolchains and can compromise IDE sessions via malicious extensions or inputs.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可触发远程代码执行。该漏洞影响开发者工具链，攻击者可通过恶意扩展或输入劫持 IDE 会话。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code allows network security feature bypass. Enables attackers to probe internal networks or exfiltrate data through the editor.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，可绕过网络安全防护。攻击者可利用该漏洞通过编辑器探测内网或外泄数据。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core enables network privilege escalation. Weakens web application security foundations built on the widely adopted framework.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在认证缺陷，可导致网络权限提升，削弱了基于该广泛采用框架构建的 Web 应用安全基础。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Internet Information Services allows network RCE. Targets the primary Microsoft web server, risking hosted applications and backend services.
items.reason_zh: Windows Internet Information Services 存在竞态条件漏洞，可触发远程代码执行。该漏洞直接针对微软核心 Web 服务器，危及托管应用与后端服务。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows remote code execution via crafted web payloads, bypassing standard authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，攻击者可绕过标准认证机制，通过构造的 Web 载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in SharePoint enables remote privilege escalation for authenticated users, compromising tenant-level security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在授权缺陷，允许已认证用户实现远程权限提升，破坏租户级安全边界。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation flaws in ASP.NET Core enable remote denial of service through unthrottled request processing and resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在资源分配缺陷，因请求处理未限速及资源耗尽可导致远程拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET frameworks allows attackers to trigger CPU exhaustion and service disruption remotely via crafted inputs.
items.reason_zh: .NET 框架存在算法复杂度缺陷，攻击者可利用构造的输入远程触发 CPU 耗尽及服务中断。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Exchange Server permits remote code execution, directly enabling email infrastructure compromise and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 存在输入验证缺陷，可导致远程代码执行，直接致使邮件基础设施沦陷并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: Untrusted input reliance in Exchange security decisions allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges, breaking server isolation controls.
items.reason_zh: Exchange 安全决策过度依赖不可信输入，允许已授权攻击者提升权限，破坏服务器隔离控制机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, posing a critical threat to web content management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，可触发网络远程代码执行，对 Web 内容管理系统构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, facilitating session hijacking and sensitive data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限，助长会话劫持与敏感数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in ASP.NET Core allows authenticated users to escalate privileges over the network, potentially granting administrative control over web applications and backend microservices.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在授权缺陷，允许已认证用户通过网络提升权限，可能导致攻击者获得对 Web 应用及后端微服务的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Critical RCE via unvalidated file uploads in jDownloads allows attackers to deploy PHP shells and fully compromise Joomla sites.
items.reason_zh: jDownloads 存在未经验证的文件上传漏洞，可导致严重远程代码执行，攻击者可借此部署 PHP Shell 并完全控制 Joomla 站点。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in jDownloads leads to immediate remote code execution, requiring urgent patching for affected web applications.
items.reason_zh: jDownloads 中的未授权任意文件上传漏洞可导致即时远程代码执行，受影响 Web 应用需紧急修补。

items.reason_en: Dangerous deserialization flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution when processing malicious payloads, impacting enterprise collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中存在危险的反序列化缺陷，在处理恶意载荷时可导致远程代码执行，影响企业协作平台。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in jDownloads allows attackers to redirect external download requests to internal networks, facilitating lateral movement and data leakage.
items.reason_zh: jDownloads 中的 SSRF 漏洞允许攻击者将外部下载请求重定向至内部网络，便于横向移动和数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Broken access control and path traversal in OpenEMR allow low-privilege users to read sensitive configuration files and overwrite arbitrary system files.
items.reason_zh: OpenEMR 中存在访问控制失效和路径遍历漏洞，低权限用户可读取敏感配置文件并覆盖任意系统文件。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in Waline's markdown preview component enables attackers to execute malicious scripts in victim browsers without sanitization.
items.reason_zh: Waline 的 Markdown 预览组件存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，攻击者可在受害者浏览器中执行恶意脚本且缺乏清理机制。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Craft CMS via manipulated Twig template signatures allows non-administrators to achieve full web application control.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS 中通过篡改 Twig 模板签名可导致远程代码执行，非管理员用户可获得完整的 Web 应用控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in OpenAM allows anonymous users to register restricted group memberships, compromising identity and access management systems.
items.reason_zh: OpenAM 中存在身份验证绕过漏洞，匿名用户可注册受限组成员资格，危及身份与访问管理系统。

items.reason_en: Craft CMS search functionality contains an unauthenticated SQL injection enabling stacked queries and full administrator account escalation.
items.reason_zh: Craft CMS 搜索功能存在未授权 SQL 注入漏洞，支持堆叠查询并可实现完整的管理员账户提权。

items.reason_en: Joomla AcyMailing extension suffers from SQL injection, granting unauthorized database access and mass data leakage across affected sites.
items.reason_zh: Joomla AcyMailing 扩展存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致未授权的数据库访问及受影响站点的大规模数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Adobe Connect stores malicious scripts in form fields via stored XSS, automatically executing JavaScript in victim browsers upon page load.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Connect 通过存储型 XSS 将恶意脚本存储在表单字段中，页面加载时会在受害者浏览器中自动执行 JavaScript。

items.reason_en: Rails Active Storage passes uploaded filenames directly to ffprobe, enabling path traversal and potential command injection in media processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Rails Active Storage 将上传的文件名直接传递给 ffprobe，可在媒体处理流水线中引发路径遍历及潜在命令注入。

items.reason_en: Quarkus REST Data Panache silently drops security role declarations during code generation, allowing unauthenticated bypasses on customized endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Quarkus REST Data Panache 在代码生成期间静默丢弃安全角色声明，导致自定义端点出现未授权绕过。

items.reason_en: Flaws in the Ninja Forms WordPress plugin allow arbitrary file deletion and cloud storage exfiltration, risking severe data loss and operational disruption for web applications.
items.reason_zh: Ninja Forms WordPress 插件存在缺陷，允许任意文件删除和云存储数据外传，可能导致 Web 应用严重数据丢失和运营中断。

items.reason_en: The Plesk Site Import extension fails to validate session identifiers, allowing path traversal that redirects privileged backend sessions and results in arbitrary code execution as root on web hosting panels.
items.reason_zh: Plesk Site Import 扩展未能验证会话标识符，导致路径遍历漏洞，可重定向高权限后端会话，并在 Web 托管面板中以 root 权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: The TMS wpDataTables WordPress plugin contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in its public endpoints, enabling attackers to extract sensitive database information without requiring authentication.
items.reason_zh: TMS wpDataTables WordPress 插件的公开端点存在盲注 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者无需认证即可提取敏感数据库信息。

items.reason_en: The VibeBP WordPress plugin permits arbitrary user meta updates due to missing capability checks, allowing subscribed users to escalate privileges and modify critical site settings.
items.reason_zh: VibeBP WordPress 插件因缺少能力检查允许任意更新用户元数据，订阅用户可利用此漏洞提权并修改关键站点设置。

items.reason_en: Email argument manipulation in ToolJet's signup endpoint may facilitate account takeover or injection attacks against low-code web development platforms.
items.reason_zh: ToolJet 注册端点的电子邮件参数操纵可能促成账户接管或针对低代码 Web 开发平台的注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft SQL Server permits remote code execution, threatening core database infrastructure and sensitive data storage.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中存在未授权的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁核心数据库基础设施及敏感数据存储。

items.reason_en: Memory leaks in the MIT Kerberos GSSAPI handler lead to kadmind resource exhaustion, disrupting enterprise authentication middleware and causing service degradation.
items.reason_zh: MIT Kerberos GSSAPI 处理器中的内存泄漏会导致 kadmind 资源耗尽，破坏企业身份验证中间件并引发服务降级。

items.reason_en: Command injection in SQL Server enables network RCE. Directly compromises database integrity and allows full system takeover through crafted queries.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的命令注入可实现网络远程代码执行。直接破坏数据库完整性，并通过构造查询实现完全的系统接管。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network RCE. Expands the attack surface for database engines exposed to external client connections.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致网络远程代码执行。扩大了暴露于外部客户端连接的数据库引擎的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Insecure temporary file permissions in .NET Aspire allow local privilege escalation. Highlights middleware configuration risks in modern cloud-native application stacks.
items.reason_zh: .NET Aspire 中不安全的临时文件权限可导致本地提权。凸显了现代云原生应用栈中中间件配置的风险。

items.reason_en: Parallel worker coordination flaw in PostgreSQL allows database users to escape sandbox restrictions and execute arbitrary operating system commands.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 并行工作器协调缺陷允许数据库用户突破沙箱限制并执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in PostgreSQL composite-value assignment enables arbitrary code execution as the database service account, bypassing standard permission models.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 复合值赋值中的类型混淆漏洞可作为数据库服务账户执行任意代码，绕过标准权限模型。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in PostgreSQL plperl triggers memory corruption during query re-entry, granting full OS-level control to authenticated database users.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL plperl 中的释放后使用漏洞在查询重新进入时触发内存损坏，使已认证的数据库用户获得完整的操作系统级控制权。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in SQL Server allow authenticated attackers to escalate privileges remotely, risking complete database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中暴露的危险方法允许已认证攻击者远程提权，面临数据库被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in PostgreSQL plperl allows arbitrary code execution by object creators, effectively breaking database sandboxing and risking host compromise.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL plperl 中的类型混淆漏洞允许对象创建者执行任意代码，实质上破坏了数据库沙箱机制并危及主机安全。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in pg_restore enables arbitrary code execution as the OS user running the restore process, bypassing standard database restrictions.
items.reason_zh: pg_restore 中输入验证不当可导致以运行还原进程的操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，绕过标准数据库限制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL text search functions allows database users to execute arbitrary code as the OS user, escalating beyond typical DB constraints.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 文本搜索函数中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许数据库用户以操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，突破典型数据库约束进行提权。

items.reason_en: Improper protection in PostgreSQL security-restricted operations allows object creators to execute arbitrary SQL, undermining database isolation and query integrity.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 安全受限操作中的保护不当允许对象创建者执行任意 SQL 语句，破坏数据库隔离性和查询完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd() permits arbitrary code execution as the database OS user, severely impacting data processing reliability.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的 ts_rank_cd() 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，严重影响数据处理可靠性。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in the SQL Server JDBC Driver allows network attackers to circumvent security controls, exposing backend data systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server JDBC Driver 存在加密签名验证绕过漏洞，允许网络攻击者规避安全控制，导致后端数据系统暴露。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in PostgreSQL's plperl extension allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as the database operating system user, severely compromising data integrity and server security.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的 plperl 扩展存在释放后使用缺陷，攻击者可借此以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，严重破坏数据完整性和服务器安全性。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in PostgreSQL's aggregate optimization can lead to arbitrary code execution under the database service account, undermining query planning safety mechanisms and exposing stored data.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的聚合优化存在类型混淆漏洞，可能导致在数据库服务账户下执行任意代码，破坏查询计划安全机制并暴露存储数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft SQL Server enables remote code execution over a network, threatening enterprise database integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过网络实现远程代码执行，威胁企业数据库的完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 type confusion in PostgreSQL operator links allows arbitrary code execution as the database OS user, compromising data processing pipelines and backend systems.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的操作符链接存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的类型混淆漏洞，允许以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，破坏数据处理管道及后端系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer wraparound in PostgreSQL tuple-size calculations enables arbitrary code execution, risking full database compromise through oversized payload manipulation.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的元组大小计算存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的整数回绕漏洞，可导致任意代码执行，通过操纵超大载荷面临数据库被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in PostgreSQL anonymous RECORD types permits arbitrary code execution as the database OS user. This breaks isolation guarantees and risks full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的匿名 RECORD 类型存在类型混淆漏洞，允许以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意代码。该漏洞破坏了隔离保证，并可能导致数据库被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network-based code execution with elevated privileges. It poses a severe threat to enterprise data infrastructure and application availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络以高权限执行代码，对企业数据基础设施和应用可用性构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in PostgreSQL trigger functions enables RCE via transition table cursors. Attackers can exploit complex query workflows to gain operating system-level access.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 触发器函数存在释放后使用漏洞，可通过转换表游标实现远程代码执行（RCE）。攻击者可利用复杂查询工作流获取操作系统级访问权限。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network, jeopardizing critical database infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，危及关键数据库基础设施。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in PostgreSQL SQL functions allows object creators to execute arbitrary code as the OS user running the database, severely compromising data integrity.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL SQL 函数存在类型混淆漏洞，允许对象创建者以运行数据库的操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，严重破坏数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Similar type confusion vulnerability in PostgreSQL enables OS-level code execution via DDL operations, posing a direct threat to database administrators and applications.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 中存在类似的类型混淆漏洞，可通过 DDL 操作实现操作系统级代码执行，对数据库管理员和应用程序构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in PostgreSQL extensions allows attackers with CREATE privileges to escalate to bootstrap superuser rights, bypassing standard database security controls.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 扩展中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许拥有 CREATE 权限的攻击者提权至引导超级用户权限，从而绕过标准数据库安全控制。

items.reason_en: Absolute-path traversal in IBM DataStage enables authenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive configuration data from cloud data platforms.
items.reason_zh: IBM DataStage 存在绝对路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者从云数据平台窃取敏感配置数据。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in IBM API Connect allows remote attackers to extract sensitive information from underlying database backends.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者从底层数据库后端提取敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Unbound SQL queries in pgEdge Postgres MCP Server permit parameter injection attacks against PostgreSQL databases via Model Context Protocol clients.
items.reason_zh: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server 中的未绑定 SQL 查询允许通过模型上下文协议客户端对 PostgreSQL 数据库发起参数注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Mongoose connection-level filter sanitization is inconsistently applied, allowing query condition bypasses in MongoDB-driven applications.
items.reason_zh: Mongoose 连接级别的过滤器清理应用不一致，导致基于 MongoDB 的应用程序可绕过查询条件。

items.reason_en: pgEdge Control Plane generates pg_hba.conf with hard-coded trust entries for loopback connections, severely weakening PostgreSQL authentication controls.
items.reason_zh: pgEdge Control Plane 生成的 pg_hba.conf 为回环连接包含硬编码的信任条目，严重削弱了 PostgreSQL 的身份验证控制。

items.reason_en: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server interpolates JSON arguments into SQL DO blocks, enabling SQL injection via Model Context Protocol database clients.
items.reason_zh: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server 将 JSON 参数插值到 SQL DO 块中，使得通过模型上下文协议数据库客户端实施 SQL 注入成为可能。

items.reason_en: MongoDB Node.js driver DNS SRV host discovery fails to strictly validate response hosts, potentially connecting to unauthorized or malicious domains.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB Node.js 驱动程序的 DNS SRV 主机发现功能未能严格验证响应主机，可能导致连接到未经授权或恶意的域名。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free condition in PostgreSQL's expanded-record domain checks allows object creators to execute arbitrary code as the database OS user, severely undermining data platform security.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 的扩展记录域检查中存在释放后使用条件，允许对象创建者以数据库操作系统用户身份执行任意代码，严重破坏数据平台安全性。

items.reason_en: Azul Payara Server's GenericAdminAuthenticator allows remote unauthenticated attackers to bypass JMX/RMI restrictions by spoofing client host addresses, granting full administrative access to application servers.
items.reason_zh: Azul Payara Server 的 GenericAdminAuthenticator 允许远程未认证攻击者通过伪造客户端主机地址绕过 JMX/RMI 限制，从而获得应用程序服务器的完全管理访问权限。

items.reason_en: TIBCO Platform’s Self-Hosted Control Plane contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow unauthorized users to access and manipulate enterprise middleware services and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: TIBCO Platform 的自托管控制平面存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可能导致未授权用户访问和操作企业中间件服务及部署流水线。

items.reason_en: ibi WebFOCUS suffers from CRLF injection flaws that enable attackers to manipulate HTTP headers, potentially performing cache poisoning or cross-site scripting attacks against business intelligence dashboards.
items.reason_zh: ibi WebFOCUS 存在 CRLF 注入缺陷，使攻击者能够操纵 HTTP 头，可能对商业智能仪表板实施缓存投毒或跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Insufficient data authenticity verification on AMD platforms bypasses Secure Debug Unlock, potentially granting local attackers unauthorized hardware-level debug access.
items.reason_zh: AMD 平台上数据真实性验证不足会绕过安全调试解锁机制，可能赋予本地攻击者未经授权的硬件级调试访问权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in the Aspire framework allow network-based attackers to bypass critical security features across mixed Linux and Windows deployments.
items.reason_zh: Aspire 框架中缺失授权检查，允许基于网络的攻击者在混合 Linux 和 Windows 部署环境中绕过关键安全功能。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows TPM allows local privilege escalation. Compromises hardware security module interactions and credential protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows TPM 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。该漏洞破坏了硬件安全模块交互及凭据保护机制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Kernel allows local privilege escalation. Represents a fundamental OS-level memory safety flaw requiring immediate patching.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核存在越界读取漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。这代表了一项根本性的操作系统级内存安全缺陷，需立即修补。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Autopilot allows local privilege escalation. Affects device provisioning workflows and initial setup security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Autopilot 存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。该漏洞影响设备配置工作流及初始设置的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code permits remote code execution, severely threatening developer workstations, IDE extensions, and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁开发者工作站、IDE 扩展及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: UI misrepresentation in VS Code tricks users into bypassing security features via deceptive network prompts, facilitating social engineering attacks.
items.reason_zh: VS Code 中的界面误导问题可通过欺骗性网络提示诱使用户绕过安全功能，从而助长社会工程学攻击。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Microsoft Defender allows remote code execution, effectively neutralizing endpoint protection capabilities upon triggering.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender 中的空指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，触发后将有效削弱端点防护能力。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information leakage in Aspire log files exposes internal system details, creating compliance violations and aiding attacker reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Aspire 日志文件中的敏感信息泄露会暴露内部系统详情，导致合规违规并辅助攻击者进行侦察。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information insertion into transmitted data in .NET Aspire could facilitate local privilege escalation, impacting cloud-native application development environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET Aspire 向传输数据中插入敏感信息可能导致本地权限提升，影响云原生应用开发环境。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via alternate channel in Windows Kerberos allows network attackers to escalate privileges, threatening enterprise identity management and domain security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 通过备用通道实现的身份验证绕过允许网络攻击者提升权限，威胁企业身份管理与域安全。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services enables network-based code execution by authorized users, risking full domain compromise and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的授权不正确允许已授权用户基于网络执行代码，存在整个域被完全入侵及横向移动的风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in datamodel-code-generator allows arbitrary command execution via crafted JSON schemas, threatening development pipelines and automated code generation tools.
items.reason_zh: datamodel-code-generator 中的代码注入漏洞允许通过构造的 JSON 模式执行任意命令，威胁开发流水线与自动化代码生成工具。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in GStreamer's H.264 RTP depayloader causes counter miscalculations that can lead to memory corruption and application crashes.
items.reason_zh: GStreamer 的 H.264 RTP depayloader 中的整数下溢会导致计数器计算错误，进而引发内存损坏与应用崩溃。

items.reason_en: Insecure update execution in Compugroup medical software allows attackers to download and run unverified code, risking healthcare system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Compugroup medical 软件中的不安全更新执行漏洞允许攻击者下载并运行未经验证的代码，存在医疗系统被入侵的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Intel PROSet Wi-Fi driver within Ring 0 enables network adversaries to trigger kernel-level denial of service conditions.
items.reason_zh: Ring 0 级 Intel PROSet Wi-Fi 驱动程序中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可使网络攻击者触发内核级拒绝服务状况。

items.reason_en: SuperTokens authentication server bypasses API-key enforcement via unknown tenant paths, compromising multi-tenant isolation in developer stacks.
items.reason_zh: SuperTokens 认证服务器通过未知租户路径绕过 API 密钥强制校验，破坏了开发者技术栈中的多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: LMDeploy toolkit validates media URLs with urlparse but sends them via requests.Session with different backslash handling, enabling SSRF attacks.
items.reason_zh: LMDeploy 工具包使用 urlparse 验证媒体 URL，但通过 requests.Session 发送时因反斜杠处理逻辑不同，从而导致 SSRF 攻击。

items.reason_en: SIPSorcery SCTP chunk parser reads attacker-controlled fields without length validation, triggering buffer overflows in WebRTC and VoIP implementations.
items.reason_zh: SIPSorcery 的 SCTP 分块解析器在未进行长度校验的情况下读取攻击者可控字段，从而在 WebRTC 和 VoIP 实现中触发缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Path traversal during model checkpoint loading in SakanaAI's text-to-LoRA framework permits attackers to access unauthorized host files, jeopardizing machine learning deployment environments.
items.reason_zh: SakanaAI 的 text-to-LoRA 框架在加载模型检查点时存在路径遍历漏洞，允许攻击者访问未授权的宿主机文件，危及机器学习部署环境。

items.reason_en: Zebra blockchain node contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability allowing unauthenticated peers to stall initial synchronization by serving forged checkpoint blocks, disrupting network consensus.
items.reason_zh: Zebra 区块链节点存在清理不彻底的漏洞，允许未经认证的节点通过提供伪造的检查点区块阻塞初始同步过程，破坏网络共识。

items.reason_en: GDB's STABS debug format parser contains a linked list removal bug that leaves destructor entries in main function lists, potentially causing debugging instability or crashes during complex C++ symbol parsing.
items.reason_zh: GDB 的 STABS 调试格式解析器存在链表移除缺陷，会在主函数列表中残留析构函数条目，可能在复杂 C++ 符号解析期间导致调试不稳定或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation flaw in Quest NetVault Backup triggers unauthenticated DoS, disrupting critical enterprise data protection and recovery services.
items.reason_zh: Quest NetVault Backup 中的数值截断缺陷会触发未经认证的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，中断关键的企业数据保护与恢复服务。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in NetVault Backup service causes unauthenticated DoS, directly compromising the availability of essential backup infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NetVault Backup 服务中的整数下溢会导致未经认证的拒绝服务（DoS），直接损害基础备份基础设施的可用性。
